schedule.prompt: An elderly gardener, a small old woman with a tight silver bun and a deep-lined weathered face wearing a moss-green cardigan, mists a wall of orchids with a small sprayer, in a Victorian glasshouse conservatory of fogged panes and hanging ferns, medium close-up, her full face clearly visible.

A broad-shouldered trader, a big man with dark umber skin, a shaved head, a thick black beard, and a burnt-orange canvas jacket hangs a glowing globe above his stall and wipes his hands, in a midnight market of paper lanterns and steaming food stalls, medium close-up, his full face clearly visible.

A young courier, a woman in her early twenties with cropped black hair and freckles, wearing a sky-blue windbreaker sprints between the coops scattering birds, then pulls up sharply at the ledge, breathing hard, in a tar rooftop with wire pigeon coops and crooked antennas at dawn, tracking shot, then medium close-up, her full face clearly visible.

The same young courier, a woman in her early twenties with cropped black hair and freckles, wearing a sky-blue windbreaker runs across at full stride, coat streaming behind her, in a stone footbridge over a still canal, bulb strings overhead, tracking shot, medium close-up, her full face clearly visible.
The ribbons fold and unfold across the stars, in green aurora ribbons swirling over a frozen tundra, wide shot.

The same elderly gardener, a small old woman with a tight silver bun and a deep-lined weathered face and the same broad-shouldered trader, a big man with dark umber skin, a shaved head, a thick black beard, and a burnt-orange canvas jacket fold a warm bedsheet between them in the aisle, laughing when it sparks with static, in an all-night laundromat with rows of humming washing machines, two shot, her face and his face both clearly visible.
